characteristics: Awards free spins or instant prizes

specs.description: Grim Muerto is a 5-reel, 20-payline Mexican Day of the Dead themed slot featuring mariachi band celebrations. The game includes wild reel duplication where highlighted reels turn fully wild, free spins with extra wild symbols, and a Second Chance pick feature for near-miss scatter combinations.

functional_symbols.name: Guitar Wild
functional_symbols.description: Substitutes for all symbols except scatters and creates winning combinations when adjacent wilds appear

functional_symbols.name: Book Scatter
functional_symbols.description: Appears on reels 1, 3, and 5 in main game, triggers free spins with 3 symbols

functional_symbols.name: Candle Scatter
functional_symbols.description: Appears during free spins on reels 1, 3, and 5, retriggers free spins
